rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: Aoki told the House that Prime Minister Obuchi (小渕総理) had been admitted to Juntendo Hospital about 01:00 on 2 April 2000 for overwork, that before 21:00 that day he was told that Obuchi had been moved to intensive care, and that Obuchi fell into a coma about 23:30.

locator.speaker: 青木幹雄 (内閣官房長官)
locator.part: paragraphs on 2 April (02:00 report, 21:00 intensive care, 23:30 coma)

rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: Aoki told the House that when he saw Prime Minister Obuchi (小渕総理) at the hospital about 19:00 on 2 April 2000, Obuchi, mindful of the Usu volcano, instructed him to take care of everything if anything happened (何かあれば万事よろしく頼む), and that before the 23:30 press conference he told 宮澤 that he would serve as acting prime minister (臨時代理) as needed under that instruction.

locator.part: paragraph beginning 午後六時ごろ, and the paragraph on the telephone call to 宮澤大蔵大臣

rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: Aoki (青木幹雄) stated that at the regular 11:00 press conference on 3 April 2000 he announced that, weighing the Usu volcano response and other urgent matters, he had accepted the acting prime ministership (臨時代理) at 09:00.

rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: Aoki (青木幹雄) stated that at the 12:40 extraordinary cabinet meeting on 3 April 2000 he reported the Prime Minister's condition and the acting designation (臨時代理指定), notified the Speakers of both Houses and had it published in the Official Gazette (官報公告).

locator.part: paragraph beginning また、同日午後十二時四十分の臨時閣議で

rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: Aoki stated that after hearing the doctors at 14:30 on 4 April 2000 he judged Prime Minister Obuchi's (小渕総理) condition to be a case where the Prime Minister is 'lacking' (欠けたとき) under Constitution art. 70, and that an extraordinary cabinet meeting at 19:00 that day decided the cabinet's resignation en masse.

bounded_scope: Head-of-government observations for CLAUDE-C01-12 only.
